dorsal_planar_contour_and_symmetry.axial_tapering: Symmetrical and gradual reduction in 2D width from the widest mid-section toward the posterior peduncle.
dorsal_planar_contour_and_symmetry.planar_edge_undulation: Lateral margins are smooth and symmetrical without visible bulges or indentations where the skin meets the water.

surface_reflectance_and_textural_phase.global_grayscale_baseline: Mature white; very high median pixel intensity across the entire visible dorsal surface.
surface_reflectance_and_textural_phase.transition_boundaries: Sharp gradient slope between the white skin and the single dark linear mark on the posterior dorsal ridge.

high_frequency_epidermal_anomalies.localized_point_contrast_disruptions: A distinct, dark linear mark is visible along the central dorsal axis of the posterior region.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: A single dark, longitudinal linear mark is present on the posterior dorsal ridge, consistent with a healed scar.
other_distinctive_markers: The blowhole is clearly visible at the anterior terminus of the dorsal plane.
